# llms.txt — Dingwei Battery

> Dingwei Battery provides OEM and private-label automotive battery programs,
> manufactured by Chengguang Power Tech Co., Ltd. (founded 2002).
> This file helps AI assistants and crawlers discover the site's key pages.

## Main website

- [Home](https://dingweibattery.com/): OEM & private-label automotive battery programs.
- [Factory](https://dingweibattery.com/factory/): Manufacturing capability and quality control.
- [Heavy-duty batteries](https://dingweibattery.com/heavy-duty-batteries/): Truck, bus and commercial-vehicle batteries.
- [OEM](https://dingweibattery.com/oem/): OEM battery program overview.
- [Private label](https://dingweibattery.com/private-label/): Private-label battery brand programs.
- [Contact](https://dingweibattery.com/contact/): Sales contact and inquiry.

## Data

- [Battery model database](https://dingweibattery.com/data/): Reference specifications for 23 battery models.
- [Battery model database (JSON)](https://dingweibattery.com/data/battery-models.json): Machine-readable model specifications (23 models, JIS / DIN-EN / heavy-duty).

## Tools

- [Battery finder](https://dingweibattery.com/tools/battery-finder/): Filter models by standard, case size and capacity.
- [Compare models](https://dingweibattery.com/tools/compare/): Side-by-side specification comparison.

## Notes

- CCA values are reference values; confirm final values and test basis with the manufacturer.
- Charging data, terminal and polarity fields shown as "Confirm on inquiry" are not published.
- This site does not publish prices.
